caption: Worked example 1 carried through its four steps: core 1.50 over cladding 1.48 gives the critical angle 80.63° inside the core, the numerical aperture 0.2441, and the acceptance angle 14.13° outside at the fibre face. The critical angle is measured inside; the acceptance angle outside, so never swap them.

spec.title: Step-index fibre: n₁ = 1.50, n₂ = 1.48
spec.aria: A five-step downward flow for the worked example: core index 1.50 and cladding index 1.48 give sine of the critical angle 0.9867, then the critical angle 80.63° inside the core, then numerical aperture 0.2441, then acceptance angle 14.13° at the fibre face, ending with a guided cone of 28.3° total.
